name: Sojrn
tagline: The operating system for company offsites
positioning: Sojrn helps enterprise People and Ops teams plan, budget, and run multi-team offsites without spreadsheets, back-and-forth threads, or last-minute chaos.

hero.h1: Run offsites your teams actually remember
hero.sub: Sojrn replaces the 40-tab planning spreadsheet with one system for venues, travel, budgets, and agendas — so Ops runs offsites like a program, not a fire drill.

features.title: Venue sourcing, sourced for you
features.description: Match team size, budget, and travel radius to vetted venues in minutes, with real availability and negotiated enterprise rates — no cold-emailing sales managers.

features.title: Live budgets per offsite
features.description: Track flights, lodging, catering, and facilitation against an approved cap. Finance sees committed spend the moment a room block is confirmed.

features.title: Agenda builder
features.description: Assemble session blocks, owners, and room assignments into a shareable run-of-show your leads can edit without breaking the master schedule.

features.title: Travel logistics that reconcile
features.description: Import attendee flights and arrival windows, auto-flag conflicts, and hand transport vendors a clean manifest instead of a messy thread.

features.title: Approvals that don't stall
features.description: Route each offsite through People, Finance, and Legal with a clear audit trail. No more chasing sign-off in Slack the week before.

features.title: Post-offsite reporting
features.description: Every offsite closes with spend-per-head, attendance, and survey results your CFO and CHRO can compare across quarters.

testimonials.quote: We ran 14 offsites across four regions last year on Sojrn. The first thing that changed: I stopped rebuilding the same budget spreadsheet every single time.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadkarni

testimonials.quote: Finance used to find out about offsite spend a month after the invoices landed. Now committed cost shows up the day we book. That alone paid for the platform.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: The agenda builder let our regional leads own their sessions without wrecking the master schedule. It made a 300-person kickoff feel manageable.
testimonials.name: Elena Sørensen
